title: Agent Query
description: Payload for `AskAgent`. Starts a turn; the IntentResult is typically a PrivateChannel used for subsequent `fdc3.ai.agentDelta` / `agentAnswer` / `agentCancel` traffic. `text` may be null or omitted for session-open.

text.title: Text
text.description: User utterance for this turn. Null/omitted for session-start.

fileIds.title: File IDs
fileIds.description: References to `fdc3.data.file` ids already delivered on this session (PrivateChannel). Omit to use all staged session files. Do not embed file bytes here.
